query: We just got 96 FASTQ pairs back from the core for the ATAC-seq project (/data/atac/run_0915). Run FastQC/MultiQC and flag outlier samples before anyone starts peak calling. Should design rank be checked when PC1/PC2 show unrelated variation, and can deleting a batch rescue complete aliasing?
Before DESeq2, check whether plate is confounded with treatment arm in our RNA-seq counts (counts/salmon_merged.tsv, sample sheet meta/samples.csv has condition and batch columns).
EPIC methylation IDATs from two array batches in /data/methyl/idat. Need bisulfite conversion, detection p-values, and sex-prediction discordance checked before the EWAS.
pls do a sample swap check on the WGS crams, sheet has declared sex + family IDs. somalier if you can
Is our VCF sane? joint-called cohort.vcf.gz from 300 exomes - want Ti/Tv, het/hom ratios and novel variant fraction before the association analysis.
A re-sequence of the samples that failed QC last month just came back. Re-run the omics QA gate on /data/runs/reseq_oct and give me GO/NO-GO.
Collaborator wants our bulk RNA-seq BAMs. Sanity-check strand specificity, intronic %, mapping and duplicate rate first so we don't ship garbage.
PCA of my count matrix looks like it splits by sequencing lane. Can you formally screen for batch effects (flag only, don't correct) against the condition variable?
bioinfo QC on /data/chip/h3k27ac --modality chipseq, sample sheet chip_samples.tsv
New ATAC-seq batch registered as data wave w3. Run the modality-appropriate QC and write the report under reports/ before the downstream team picks it up.
Profile the columns of data/raw/icu_extract.parquet and give me a GO/NO-GO data quality gate before I finalize the SAP.
Our VCFs are hg19 but the annotation is GRCh38 - pin the genome build, contig naming, and plan the liftover.
Review the Snakefile and rules/*.smk in this diff for pipeline correctness before merge.
Run DESeq2 for sepsis vs control with batch as a covariate and produce a volcano plot of the results.
Apply ComBat-seq to remove the plate effect from counts.tsv and save the corrected matrix.
salmon quant is crashing with 'std::bad_alloc' on three of the samples; figure out why and fix the Nextflow config.
Validate that the lab values in the EHR extract are in plausible ranges and the missingness matches what the cohort spec expects.
Quick sanity check of the analysis step I just finished: sample size, effect direction, missingness, any PHI in the figures.
Write the Methods paragraph describing our batch-confound assessment and sensitivity analysis for the manuscript.
Validate our sepsis phenotype definition and code list against chart review expectations.
